# rustic_backend 0.6.1 provenance

This directory is a vendored copy of the crates.io package
`rustic_backend` 0.6.1. The pristine source, manifest, README, and license
files match the registry package checksum:

`02bd2f9c5b02e692175d8a7d7131ee39f6f89a60c43de3d0acdbe24093e722d3`

The only semantic source change is the constructor-only OpenDAL HTTP-client injection
hook documented in the capture contract at
`docs/burn-in/r2-http-capture.md`.

Two upstream trailing spaces in `src/util.rs` were removed for diff hygiene.
